title: Correlated States in Flat Chern Bands: From Dispersion to Quantum Geometry
summary: From 120-degree magnetic order and SOC in ReAg2Cl6 to band eigenvectors, projected interactions and competing FCIs/CDWs. Independent flat-band counterexamples and a recount of 1088 versus 168 particle-entanglement levels show what computational materials studies must compare.
